reasons.actionNotPerformed: The agent finished without doing what it was built to do. Open the run to see which step it skipped.
reasons.noExecutor: This agent asks for something the CRM cannot do yet. It needs rebuilding.
reasons.dependencyUnavailable: A connection this agent needs is missing. Reconnect it, then run again.
reasons.notAuthorised: The connection refused this. Its access may have been revoked or narrowed.
reasons.providerError: The outside service rejected this. It is usually worth trying again.
reasons.neverSettled: The agent stopped without reporting a result. Nothing was left half-done.
reasons.turnFailed: The model failed part-way through this run.
reasons.deliveryFailed: The run never reached the agent.
reasons.deliveryExhausted: This never reached the agent after three attempts. Nothing ran.
reasons.actionRejected: The agent tried the action and the CRM refused it. Nothing was written.
reasons.agentUnavailable: The agent was paused or archived when this run started.
reasons.agentDeleted: The agent was deleted before this run finished.
reasons.runTimedOut: This run took too long and was stopped so later runs could start.

runFailure.unknown: This run failed without saying why.
